sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection check list I1 to be performed on a monthly as indicated 
by M1 in the above title block.

The 12v-71- detroit diesel engine (starting - 500HP detroit diesel engine), 
the diesel is a 12 cylinder, 2 cycle 
engine, with a speed rating of 2300 rpm.

The first draft initiated by 
 eng. Ayma Elmor, reviewed by eng. Aly 
 Mohamed Fahmy, 
 tested by eng. Abdel Hameed Abd Alla, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. 
 Samir abdel Gilil: EDEPC 
 inspection & quality control 
 general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 approved by eng. Sawsan El-Lithe: general 
 director of Port Said PS.

This document 
 accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil: EDEPC 
 inspection & quality control 
 general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman: EDEPC 
 planning & financial predicting and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued,

The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID 
 safety category.
Safety fence with caution mark surrounding the work area is required.

Wear your safety, helmet, safety shoes, eye glass, nose mouth dust cover .. 
 etc
The diesel engine must be shut down for oil checks.

sections.text: Remedy

Refill diesel oil super 
duty (25/50) until the operating mark level (if needed to increase).

If the working oil 
contains contamination and dilution:
Open the drain plug.

After drainage change the oil filter by a new one and 
retight the drain plug.
Refill a new fresh oil as recommended with 32 liters.
